summary: Iteration 6 full-stack testing of the unified Pipeline interlink feature. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_pipeline_interlink.py with 9 tests covering (a) GET /api/pipeline returns leads+deals with kind/stage/value shape, (b) client role gets 403 on /api/pipeline, (c) POST /api/leads auto-creates linked contact + company (verified via /api/leads/{id}, /api/contacts, /api/companies), (d) POST /api/pipeline/lead/{id}/stage persists stage for Contacted, (e) Proposal stage creates linked proposal draft (lead_id set), (f) Negotiation creates linked contract draft, (g) Won triggers lead->deal conversion + client & project creation + proposals marked Accepted (verified in /api/deals, /api/proposals; converted lead removed from pipeline feed), (h) client role 403 on stage move, (i) Deal Proposal stage creates linked proposal (deal_id). All 9 tests pass. Frontend: Pipeline page (/pipeline) renders all 8 stage columns, legend Lead/Deal visible, 16 lead-card-* + 15 deal-card-* rendered, Contacted column contains lead cards; created new lead via /leads?new=1 dialog and confirmed auto-linked contact (visible on /contacts) and company (visible on /companies); quick-stage-proposal on lead detail slide-over shows 'Proposal draft created' toast and the linked proposal appears on /proposals; client@demo.com is redirected away from /pipeline (board not rendered).

issues: Radix a11y console warnings persist: 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle' emitted twice on lead detail sheet interactions. Non-blocking; wrap missing titles with VisuallyHidden.

action_items: Optional a11y: add VisuallyHidden DialogTitle/DialogDescription to Sheet/CommandDialog to silence Radix warnings.

Native HTML5 drag-and-drop on Pipeline was not simulated in Playwright (browsers don't dispatch synthetic dragstart reliably); the underlying endpoint POST /api/pipeline/{kind}/{id}/stage is validated end-to-end via backend tests + the Leads quick-stage buttons which call the same endpoint.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py apply_stage_effects: idempotency check uses (org_id, key=entity['id']) which is good — repeated moves to Proposal/Negotiation won't duplicate drafts.

server.py won_conversion: acts logically but does not append proposals-accepted (that is in apply_stage_effects for 'won'); currently order is apply_stage_effects then won_conversion, which is correct.
Pipeline.jsx has no data-testid on the stage-legend chips; consider adding them for future assertions.
server.py is now ~1180 lines — still recommend splitting into routers.
list_resource still passes raw query_params into scope; unchanged risk from iteration 5.
